glen-allen-church-of-christ.assessment: Glen Allen Church of Christ follows the Restorationist tradition with elder-led governance. Churches of Christ historically hold to baptismal regeneration and a cappella worship. Leadership includes Tommy South and Chris Langley. While Churches of Christ affirm Scripture authority and conservative morality, the soteriology (baptism as necessary for salvation) is a significant departure from faith-alone soteriology. Evaluate carefully.

score_notes.christology: Site affirms Jesus as 'the only way to God, the Father' — Christ-exclusivity present.
score_notes.scripture: Restoration Movement 'speak where the Bible speaks' hermeneutic; no Chicago-Statement-style inerrancy phrasing.
score_notes.gender: Leadership roster not published; traditional a cappella Churches of Christ are generally complementarian in practice.
score_notes.leadership: Leadership page lists Tommy South and Linda South, plus Chris Langley and Katie Langley — paired-name format (often husband-wife co-leadership style in Restoration Movement tradition). Traditional Churches of Christ polity assigns shepherds/elders to men, but the paired listing warrants verification whether women serve as co-elders or in supporting roles.
score_notes.soteriology: Traditional Churches of Christ hold baptismal regeneration (water baptism as required for salvation) — red per rubric (sacramental regeneration).
score_notes.cultural: No DEI/CRT language; traditional Churches of Christ are typically culturally conservative.
score_notes.denominational: Confirmed a cappella (non-instrumental) traditional Church of Christ per their own site; no denominational HQ but Restoration-Movement heritage.
